defect.explanation: The provenance validator incorrectly required every live model revision to equal one particular export identity. Fresh75 truthfully uses the immutable payload-manifest digest, while the previously accepted Teacher route truthfully uses the export-receipt digest. The revision actually used by a route is fixed by its create-once registration plan and result. Export-receipt, payload-manifest, route-plan, and route-result identities are distinct and must remain separately verifiable. The same checkpoint schema also has two known producer-era field sets: Fresh75 records compact training progress, while Teacher and Self record the selected reference-loss checkpoint plus both the raw source-plan file hash and its canonical JSON hash. Rejecting those truthful fields or pretending the two source-plan hashes have one meaning would create a second false identity rule.
defect.fail_closed_behavior: The candidate campaign was not created while the identities disagreed.

repair.behavior: Keep the export receipt and payload-manifest identities separate. Require the observed live model revision, model name, staged path, runtime contract, and historical registration receipt to match the exact self-digested create-once route plan and result. Continue binding the exported bytes by their payload manifest and the export evidence by its own receipt and file digests. Dispatch the two known checkpoint field sets exactly: the compact form binds its canonical source-plan digest, while the reference-loss form separately binds the raw source-plan file hash and the canonical JSON digest and validates the fixed checkpoint-selection contract.
regression_gates: a Fresh75 route whose exact plan uses the payload-manifest revision is accepted
a Teacher-style route whose exact plan uses the export-receipt revision is accepted without conflating that revision with the payload manifest
an observation whose revision differs from the exact route plan is rejected
tampered or mismatched route plans and create-once results are rejected
both known checkpoint-manifest field sets validate without dropping immutable fields, while unknown fields and source-plan hash drift fail closed
candidate launch fixtures carry all six exact evidence files through registration and live parity
